name: provable-settlement-engine
description: Server-authoritative money core with a double-entry ledger, idempotent payment ingestion and reproducible settlement outcomes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w api run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w api run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.test: npm -w api run test && npm -w web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w api run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
